injection_details.method: Process forking / "ghost process hollowing": NtCreateProcess (SectionHandle = NULL) clones the current process, then NtAllocateVirtualMemory + NtWriteVirtualMemory + NtCreateThreadEx execute the decrypted shellcode inside the cloned child. No CreateRemoteThread/WriteProcessMemory (Win32) calls are used.
injection_details.target_process: A forked clone of itself (own process is the ParentProcess); no third-party/foreign process is targeted
injection_details.target_discovery: GetCurrentProcessId() -> OpenProcess(PROCESS_CREATE_PROCESS 0x80, FALSE, ownPid) to obtain a parent handle, which is passed as ParentProcess to NtCreateProcess
injection_details.payload_write: NtAllocateVirtualMemory(hChild, base=NULL, size=0x40, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE 0x3000, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE 0x40) then NtWriteVirtualMemory(hChild, remoteBase, decrypted 64-byte buffer, 0x40, &bytesWritten)
injection_details.execution: NtCreateThreadEx(&hThread, 0x1FFFFF, NULL, hChild, StartRoutine=remoteBase, Argument=NULL, flags=0, ...) followed by WaitForSingleObject(hThread, 5000)
injection_details.cleanup: NtClose(hThread), NtClose(hChildProcess), CloseHandle(hParent); process then Sleep(2000) and exits
injection_details.resolved_native_apis: NtQueryInformationProcess, NtCreateProcess, NtAllocateVirtualMemory, NtWriteVirtualMemory, NtCreateThreadEx, NtResumeThread (resolved but unused), NtClose

encryption_details.algorithm: Repeating-key (Vigenere-style) byte XOR — xor_crypt() @ 0x140001480: data[i] ^= key[i % keylen]
encryption_details.key_storage: Hard-coded plaintext ASCII in .rdata at VA 0x140004000 (symbol g_xor_key); it is the first string of a contiguous string blob that also holds the plaintext API/module names.
